signals.title: Pazardzhik Svoboda Island Park Excursion
signals.reason: A proven family favorite featuring shaded walking paths, small animal enclosures, and extensive playgrounds just a 35-minute drive from Plovdiv.
signals.note: Verified family-friendly public park in Pazardzhik, well within the 90-minute driving radius.

signals.title: Aviation Museum Krumovo
signals.reason: Spacious open-air grounds filled with real jet fighters, passenger aircraft, and helicopters where a toddler can safely roam and admire big machines.
signals.note: evergreen — known-real, no skeptic verdict needed

signals.title: Byala Reka Ecotrail
signals.reason: A gentle, scenic ecotrail featuring easy wooden bridges over mountain streams that feel like an exciting adventure for a 4-year-old without steep hazards.
signals.note: evergreen — known-real, no skeptic verdict needed
